samples: This module is a pure pricing calculator that a host application calls at checkout: given a parcel's weight, destination (domestic, Europe or international) and order total, it returns a quote with the shipping cost, the delivery time in business days, and whether shipping is free. The cost is a flat base price per destination plus 2.50 for each started kilogram beyond the first, and delivery takes 2, 5 or 10 business days by region. Domestic orders totalling 50.00 or more ship free, and the parcel can be read from JSON and the quote written back as JSON. The module performs no I/O, so it is safe to embed, and the examples in its documentation match the logic I traced.

This module is a pure shipping-quote calculator for a host application: given a parcel's weight, destination (domestic, Europe or international) and order total, it returns a cost, a delivery time in business days (2, 5 or 10 by destination) and whether shipping is free. The cost is a base price per destination plus 2.50 for each whole kilogram beyond the first, and domestic orders at or above 50.00 ship free regardless of weight, while Europe and international orders never do. It needs no permissions, takes parcels that can be read from JSON and returns quotes that can be written as JSON, so it is easy to embed; one thing to check before relying on it is that the free-shipping branch yields a plain whole-number zero where a decimal cost is expected, which Renyi's no-implicit-conversion rule may reject.

This module is a pure, side-effect-free pricing calculator that a host application calls at checkout: given a parcel's weight, destination (domestic, Europe or international) and order total, it returns a quote with the shipping cost, delivery time in business days, and whether shipping is free. Domestic orders of 50.00 or more ship free; every other parcel pays a flat rate by region (4.90 domestic, 9.50 Europe, 19.90 international) plus 2.50 for each full kilogram beyond the first. Delivery is promised in 2, 5 or 10 business days by region, and the parcel and quote types can be read from and written to JSON, so it is easy to embed, with the rates and threshold fixed in the code rather than configurable.

This module is a pure shipping-quote calculator, with no I/O or permissions, that a host application calls at checkout. Given a parcel's weight, destination (domestic, Europe or international) and order total, it returns a cost, an estimated delivery time of 2, 5 or 10 business days by destination, and whether shipping is free. Domestic orders at or above 50 ship free. Everything else pays a flat rate by destination plus 2.50 for each whole kilogram beyond the first, and the parcel and quote types convert from and to JSON so they are easy to exchange with the host.

This module calculates the shipping quote for one parcel: given its weight in grams, destination (domestic, Europe or international) and order total, it returns the cost, the delivery time in business days, and whether shipping is free. The price is a fixed base rate per region (4.90, 9.50 or 19.90) plus 2.50 for each started kilogram beyond the first, and delivery takes 2, 5 or 10 business days. Domestic orders of 50.00 or more ship free, but still take 2 days. The calculation is pure, with no network, file or other side effects, and parcels can be read from JSON and quotes written as JSON, so it suits embedding in a host application. All rates, the free-shipping threshold and the delivery times are hardcoded, so any pricing change means editing the code, and no currency is specified.
